LanguageData.LP_HalfIllithidGene.label: half-illithid
LanguageData.LP_HalfIllithidGene.description: The tadpole was suppressed halfway by the suppressant; the host kept their self but also gained part of a mind flayer's power: can read minds and devour brains (needs no brain matter and gains none). Each humanlike brain devoured teaches one psionic power (psychic blast, telekinetic throw, psionic concealment in order, up to 3). Not upset by witnessing brain devouring.
LanguageData.LP_HalfIllithidGene.customEffectDescript: Psionics are free, limited only by cooldown.
Each humanlike brain devoured: learn one psionic power (up to 3); 25% chance to break the suppressant.
